---
description: Write a requirement package's user stories, one per affected component, from its impact analysis
agent: story-writer
argument-hint: "<work item id>"
---

Write the stories for work item ${input:id:the work item id, e.g. REQ-101} from its requirement package:
`work/<id>/impact.md` and the files it cites. Local mode: write them to `work/<id>/stories/`.
